title: Checks for doc lines that exceed the specified maximum character length.
summary: For flowing long blocks of text (docstrings or comments), overlong lines can hurt readability. PEP 8, for example, recommends that such lines be limited to 72 characters, while this rule enforces the limit specified by the lint.pycodestyle.max-doc-length setting. (If no value is provided, this rule will be ignored, even if it's added to your --select list.) Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.219.
